purpose: Supplement dated residual UTA reviews without rewriting the 2026-09-23 frozen baseline.

entries.title: Fire King
entries.reason: The current UTA audit found no title candidate for the 1989 Strategic Studies Group C64 release. No tape-archive link may be assigned unless a compatible source is verified. This records absence from the scanned archive, not proof that no cassette release ever existed.

entries.title: Wasteland
entries.reason: The 1988 Electronic Arts Commodore 64 Wasteland release is documented on 5.25-inch retail floppy disks (Lemon64 and BetaArchive). The current UTA 2,900-release scan found no title candidate. No UTA cassette directory can be linked without additional evidence; this is not proof that no tape version ever existed.
